events.verdict: Vucevic (ORL) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Beal (WAS) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Green (WAS) and Vucevic (ORL) briefly engage and separate off ball.
Green (ORL) briefly grasps Vucevic's (ORL) jersey off ball, but releases it and does not affect his FOM.
Green (WAS) briefly has two hands on Vucevic (ORL) in the post, but removes them and does not affect his SQBR.
Green (WAS) maintains a legal guarding position during Vucevic's (ORL) shot attempt.
Vucevic (ORL) makes incidental head contact with Green (WAS) during his natural shooting motion.
Fournier (ORL) briefly grasps Green's (WAS) hip but immediately releases him.
Green (WAS) sets the screen on Fournier (ORL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Green (WAS) makes contact with Vucevic's (ORL) arm and affects his shot attempt.
Green (WAS) sets the screen on Fournier (ORL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Gordon (ORL) makes marginal contact with Green (WAS) during his shooting motion that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Satoransky (WAS) maintains a legal guarding position on Gordon (ORL) at the start of the drive.
Ariza (WAS) cleanly steals the ball from Gordon (ORL).
Ross (ORL) commits a take foul on Satoransky (WAS).
Fournier (ORL) maintains a legal guarding position on Beal (WAS) before the steal occurs.
Beal (WAS) moves the ball forward into Vucevic's (ORL) knee causing it to become dislodged.
Satoransky (WAS) jumps from A to B into Augustin (ORL) and makes contact with his legs that affects his SQBR.
Vucevic (ORL) commits a take foul on Ariza (WAS).
